 (By Shri Dinesh P. Patel, Dy. Govt. Advocate)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order
Earlier bail application was considered on merits and dismissed.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that earlier bail application was dismissed on 25.04.2022 in M.Cr.C.No.7844/2022 and applicant was granted liberty to file repeat bail application after examination of material witnesses.
It is submitted that prosecutrix has already been examined.
Now, there is no chance that applicant will be able to influence witness and tamper with evidence of the case.
Looking to the period of custody and the fact that material witness has been examined, applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that one more criminal offence is registered against applicant.
Offence committed by applicant is heinous in nature.
Applicant also remained absconding for sometime.
In these circumstances, application filed by applicant may be dismissed.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix in the case has already been examined.
Applicant is in jail for more than one year.
Material witness has already been examined and previous case, which has been registered against applicant, is old and minor offences are registered against the applicant.
6 . Considering aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.

8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C as per rules.
